name: Protective Asset Allocation - EM Equity Universe + 15% Vol Target
description: Keller & Keuning PAA applied to emerging-market equities with VUTY bonds as safe asset, scaled to 15% vol overlay. Allocates to EM equities proportionally to how many pass their 12-month SMA trend test, shifting remaining weight to VUTY bonds when EM markets are in downtrend. Provides regime-aware drawdown control across emerging markets.
